title: Capture Child Output Through a Pipe
prompt: POSIX. Implement `int capture_child(const char *cmd, char *out, size_t cap)` — fork, redirect the child's stdout into a pipe created before the fork, exec `/bin/sh -c cmd`, read until EOF into out (at most cap-1 bytes, NUL-terminate), waitpid, and return the child's exit code (or -1 on any setup failure).

tests.name: captures stdout
tests.hint: Pipe before fork, dup2 in the child, read to EOF in the parent: the child's stdout lands in buf.

tests.name: propagates exit code
tests.hint: The shell exits 3; waitpid + WEXITSTATUS report it.

tests.name: empty output on silent child
tests.hint: A child that writes nothing yields an empty, terminated buffer.
